title: OHCHR documentation of hostage treatment in Gaza
summary: OHCHR reviewed information about hostages held in Gaza between 7 October 2023 and 30 June 2024.
claim: OHCHR documented released hostages’ accounts of inadequate food, water and medical care, poor sanitary conditions, beatings and other ill-treatment while held by Palestinian armed groups in Gaza.
legal_characterization: Documented accounts relevant to hostage-taking and alleged cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment; not a judicial finding or conviction.
source_organization: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
source_title: Detention in the context of the escalation of hostilities in Gaza (7 October 2023 - 30 June 2024)
verification_notes: Verified against the cited sections of the OHCHR thematic report, including its scope and methodology. OHCHR documents accounts and information; this record does not treat every reported incident as an adjudicated finding.
